$Comment: The quick contract on the two-hour board: a short run of boards off the Sawmill. STATION_OUTPUT counts every cut of every species the mill hands over ('Wood_' on PREFIX, qualified to the Sawmill, so planks from a Builder's Workbench do not count) and carries the shared mill_lumber TextKey, since the kind's default line names a single item. This file spells out its whole step and pay rather than inheriting a shared skeleton, so it loads with nothing but this pack, RPG Stations and the MMO installed; it hangs on the Bihourly board by id, and on a server with no board of that id it is simply never posted. The stations feature condition in Requires hides the contract rather than locking it: it is lifted out of the gate when the contract loads and the board's draw reads it live, so on a server where stations have been switched off the contract never takes a slot and is never posted, rather than being offered and refused at Accept.
